name: WMT 2022 Translation Suggestion Shared Task
description: Shared-task benchmark evaluating systems' ability to provide useful translation suggestions for segments using provided datasets, automatic metrics, and human judgments.
evaluation_method: automatic metrics (BLEU/chrF/COMET) combined with human evaluation (human judgment of usefulness/acceptability)
reputation: Part of the annual WMT shared tasks, which are prestigious and widely followed in the MT community; this particular task is respected for focusing on translation suggestion interfaces.
notes: Language-pair performance varies widely; human evaluation is a primary signal. Possible data-specific caveats include dependency on reference corpora and potential overlap between training data and shared-task test sets for some systems.
